messages:
Anya: quick heads-up — after landing kernel-selector v2 I see PP bubble growth on 1F1B microbatch runs, especially with microbatch=2. attaching short perf dump.
Matt: can you paste the profile snippet or flame?
Anya: pasted below (nvprof-like): 
```
step  | compute(ms) | allreduce(ms) | kv_handoff(ms)
1     | 22.4        | 5.1           | 0.8
2     | 24.9        | 6.3           | 12.2  <-- spike during kvcache evict
3     | 23.1        | 5.0           | 0.9
...
```
Anya: note the compute for some microbatches increased ~10-12% vs baseline; timeline shows compute bleeding past expected window so all-reduce waits.
Sophie: hmm kernel-selector v2 favors blocked GEMM for fwd on seq>1024; that can increase latency but improve throughput normally. For 1F1B we care about tail/overlap.
Kai: could also be kvcache handoff contending with comm stream — the kvcache eviction path does CUDAMemcpy+host staging in our impl.
Anya: yes, kvcache eviction calls look like `kvcache::handoff_async(stream_comm)` which ends up serializing on comm stream sometimes.
Frank: in previous perf regressions we fixed by reducing allreduce fusion size (param reduce_allreduce_fusion=1). Did we try that here?
Anya: not yet. planning experiments:
- revert kernel-selector to v1 to confirm
- run microbatch sweep: {1,2,4,8}
- toggle reduce_allreduce_fusion {1,2,4}
- run with kvcache_prefetch_threshold=0.2/0.5/1.0
Matt: can you paste the command you used to reproduce?
Anya:
```
./run_infer.sh --model gpt-xl --pp 8 --microbatch 2 --profile=nvtx --kernel-selector=heuristicV2 --kvcache_prefetch=0.5
```
InfraBot: CI profile job queued: job_id=rf-2382, link: https://ci.internal/jobs/rf-2382
Sophie: Also capture kernel timelines with ncu --target-processes=all and check memcpy ordering vs nccl comms.
Kai: Another quick check — try `--comm-priority=low` on kvcache memcpy stream so it yields to nccl.
Lee: I think we have an open PR that changed `kvcache::handoff_async` to use the same stream as staging; that should be optional. PR #1423
Anya: good call, I'll test toggling that flag (kvcache_use_separate_stream=true/false).
Frank: if revert to v1 removes bubble, we should open rollback and then iterate slower on kernel-selector heuristics.
Anya: status: running baseline job (v1 + microbatch=2) now; expect results in ~20m. I'll post flame graphs and a short timeline diff when done.
Matt: thanks. if you get a repro, I'll help instrument allreduce with NCCL_TRACE=1 and add wall-clock markers.
Anya: ack. action items: Anya run sweep + dump timelines; Sophie/Kai add ncu/nccl traces; Frank/Lee check PR #1423 and reduce_allreduce_fusion knob; Matt stand by for trace analysis.
InfraBot: job rf-2382 started at 2043210030
Anya: small update — baseline run finished: v1 shows 18% less bubble time vs v2 on same config. uploading traces.
Sophie: nice. schedule a quick 15m sync if needed.
Matt: +1
Anya: pinging @eng-runtime for visibility :pray:
